selection: Original sampling fields and cost aggregates; job/cache identifiers, full annotations, and individual batch records omitted.

taxonomy_revision.sample_method: Uniform random sample without replacement from triples not present in the prior reviewed union.

inductive_changes.change: Added F33 Privatize Public Authority and Resources
inductive_changes.reason: Two clear triples described officials using jurisdiction and procedure to shield clients, obstruct justice, falsify interrogation, or appropriate public authority for private ends; neither anti-leakage enforcement nor generic noncompliance captured their purpose.

inductive_changes.change: Discarded the seed category Evade, Refuse, or Withhold Obligations
inductive_changes.reason: Refusal was a surface form rather than a stable political purpose. The sampled cases resolved into throne contest, elite containment, internal resistance, autonomy, rival-center realignment, private appropriation, defense, or no clear purpose.

inductive_changes.change: Merged collective deliberation and implementation into F07
inductive_changes.reason: The two sampled cases were adjacent manifestations of constituting and coordinating governing institutions, not a separate recurrent purpose.

inductive_changes.change: Merged colonial replacement into F18 external domination
inductive_changes.reason: Ultimata, disarmament, annexation, occupation, and colonial jurisdiction served the same political purpose as conquest and supersession of another sovereign order; a period-specific label would overfit the actor.

taxonomy_revision.interpretation: The sample informed category revisions; this is a development audit, not an independent test of the finished taxonomy.

extraction_run.mode: Batch API with explicit prefix cache
extraction_run.excludes: Five earlier high-thinking test pages were reused and incurred no new cost in this production run.
extraction_run.interpretation: Historical estimate for this extraction pass including recorded retries/salvage; not an invoice or the whole-project cost.
